newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arab stabs Israeli at Gaza-Egypt crossing.
newsitem.headline: Arab stabs Israeli at Gaza-Egypt crossing.

text.p: An Arab stabbed an Israeli inspector at the Gaza-Egyptian border on Thursday during a security check of a Palestinian tourist bus bound for Egypt, Israel Radio said.

It said the Israeli was in fair condition. The stabbing took place at a border roadblock in Rafah in the self-ruled Gaza Strip. The bearded assailant got off the bus along with other passengers during a security check and attacked, the radio said.

It said Israeli soldiers arrested the man. Israel has overall responsibility for security at border crossings, including in Palestinian-ruled Gaza, under peace deals with Yasser Arafat's Palestine Liberation Organisation.
